comparison_policy: Replay uses the actual active camera stored with each source 3dm. Surface picks use perspective projection and integer device coordinates; view-free APIs retain model-space selection.

B-rep vertex and edge tables are matched bijectively modulo permutation and edge parameter direction. Counts, face orientation, loop/trim counts, coordinates and endpoint errors retain the same epsilon.
Only the two unused outer knot slots omitted by RhinoCommon are normalized. Active knots, degrees, controls, weights, domains and samples are compared.
Subcurve outputs normalize fresh identifiers; source identity, metadata, selection and geometry-changing Undo/Redo are checked.
VIEW_DIAGNOSTIC rows compare alternate camera choices to the Perspective reference and are not native-comparison audit rows.
The test geometry crate uses opt-level=2 to accelerate bounded boundary certificates; other test dependencies retain their test profile. No fast-math or comparison-tolerance change is used.

diagnostics.note: Owned public-API probes confirm that changing Perspective to Top changes the selected knot line. Face and surface closest-point queries recover the same source UV, separating projection choice from inverse evaluation. Diagnostic drivers only instrument staged copies of our own helpers.

limits: This increment does not complete Rhino command coverage or establish a general performance claim.
Native metadata-only Undo/Redo records are not captured; Rust command results do not expose the full native Cancel/Failure enum.

Native boundary snapshots retain edge endpoints, not complete spatial edge definitions. Rebuilt nonrectangular edges certify against their surface image at document tolerance/4 (capture absolute tolerance 1e-6). The 1e-8 figure applies to the retained definitions/samples/endpoints.
Native samples do not establish a continuous whole-model comparison certificate.
Projected picking currently requires guide control hulls in front of the camera. High-DPI parity, complete display/status-panel parity and all camera configurations remain unqualified.
Periodic captures use degree-three sources. Repeated composite-joint captures have two leaves; larger repeated composite workflows remain unqualified.
Numeric temporary shortening inherits shared input tests but has no new RemoveKnot-specific native capture.

Polysurfaces and block members are excluded. Two sharp transverse deformations automatically become polysurfaces in Rhino; their failure rows are retained alongside successful smooth periodic tensor deformations.
No new edited-3dm roundtrip matrix is included.
